files.title: Linkage QTL
files.description: De-duplicated linkage-mapping QTL with trait, population, position, LOD, PVE, markers and source.

files.title: GWAS loci
files.description: GWAS associations grouped into loci (one row per locus), with lead SNP and strongest P.

files.title: GWAS associations (all)
files.description: Every de-duplicated GWAS association (SNP–trait), with position, P, PVE, candidate genes and source.

files.title: Epistatic QTL pairs
files.description: QTL × QTL interaction pairs with both loci, statistics and source.

files.title: QTL clusters reported by authors
files.description: Clusters and pleiotropic regions as labelled in the source tables.

files.title: Multi-trait QTL within studies
files.description: Overlapping linkage QTL (Mb or cM) and shared GWAS signals (same SNP or within 100 kb) for two or more traits in one study.

files.title: Multi-trait QTL members
files.description: Which records make up each within-study multi-trait QTL (mt_id, record_id, trait).

files.title: Cloned and validated genes
files.description: Genes behind mapped loci (map-based cloning, fine mapping, QTL, GWAS) with validation method, trait, chromosome and paper.

files.title: Qualitative trait loci (MTL)
files.description: Mendelian trait loci and gene symbols from CottonGen.

files.title: QTL and GWAS on every assembly
files.description: Each placed QTL and GWAS locus with its position converted to every supported genome assembly.

files.title: All loci on TM-1 UTX v2.1
files.description: Position of every placed record on the common reference, and how it was converted.

files.title: Physical meta-QTL
files.description: Meta-QTL on TM-1 UTX v2.1 (Mb) for each trait: position, 95% CI, studies, evidence, candidate genes, hotspot.

files.title: Physical meta-QTL members
files.description: Which records make up each physical meta-QTL (mqtl_id, record_id).

files.title: Genetic-map meta-QTL
files.description: Classic meta-QTL on the consensus genetic map (cM): position, 95% CI, flanking markers, studies, matching physical meta-QTL.

files.title: Genetic-map meta-QTL members
files.description: Which linkage QTL make up each genetic-map meta-QTL (mqtl_id, record_id).

files.title: Meta-QTL model selection
files.description: Every trait × chromosome model fitted: observations, studies, components chosen by BIC (and AIC for the genetic map).

files.title: Trait coverage of the meta-analyses
files.description: Every database trait with its records and the outcome of the physical and genetic-map meta-analyses.

files.title: Published meta-QTL
files.description: Rows from the tables of published cotton meta-analyses (their own consensus maps, cM).

files.title: Multi-trait meta-QTL clusters
files.description: Physical meta-QTL of different traits sharing one core interval on UTX v2.1 (CI <= 5 Mb).

files.title: Hotspots
files.description: Study-supported hotspot regions with traits, studies, example QTL and candidate genes.

files.title: Study support per 2-Mb window
files.description: Independent studies, loci and traits in every 2-Mb window, with the permutation q-value.

files.title: Gene expression in TM-1 organs
files.description: TPM of every UTX v2.1 gene in 11 TM-1 organs (PRJNA248163; Zhang et al. 2015), organ-group means, tissue specificity, peak organ and fibre-preferential call (scripts/export_expression.py).

files.title: Consensus genetic map
files.description: Consensus map built around the AD genome-wide reference map (2009): marker, chromosome, cM, first map, number of maps.

files.title: Consensus map construction
files.description: Every linkage group considered: shared markers, anchors used, markers added, or why it was left out.

files.title: QTL on the consensus map
files.description: Linkage QTL projected onto the consensus map (cM), with method and whether the interval was imputed.

files.title: Linkage maps (index)
files.description: All genetic maps: population, parents, marker types, loci, length, source and reference.

files.title: Linkage maps (all loci)
files.description: Every marker of every linkage map in one file (map, marker, type, linkage group, chromosome, cM, primers).

files.title: Trait-linked markers
files.description: Marker–trait links graded by evidence, with primers where known.

files.title: Marker primers
files.description: Primer sequences collected from CottonGen and mapping papers, by marker.

files.title: Trait dictionary
files.description: Original trait names and the harmonised trait and category assigned to each, by source.

files.title: Studies
files.description: Studies contributing records, with sources and record counts.

files.title: Literature index
files.description: Cotton QTL / GWAS papers indexed, with study-type flags and links.

files.title: Validation issues
files.description: Every record flagged by the validation checks, with the check and the study.
